Initial rough effect captures, the favicon-404 WebGPU attempt, the pre-single-pass 14.001 batch and the mislabeled Old Town/Ultra-timeout profile attempt remain separate and are not final passing checks. The final busy-v3 collector verifies the actual Downtown district and bounds/persists setup stages.
The explicit lab uses synthetic static geometry/car to isolate optional effect pixels/resources; it is not gameplay/FPS acceptance.
The built-game spark check uses the existing real circuit/wall and physics contact events, not injected damage/rewards.
Busy measurements have zero manual steps during measurement; initial positioning/density/stars/setup steps are disclosed.
Current source extraction is compared with local candidate output, not stale public 0.13 bytes.

Release date is a metadata label, not the final run date. The profiler hardcodes stale date/timezone labels; its ISO capturedAt/stage Z timestamps and the batch startedAt/finishedAt give actual recorded UTC provenance. Raw reports and tested collector hashes are preserved.
limitations: Native Radeon 840M-class 1080p60 and reported lag remain unaccepted; software observations are not promoted to a target-device pass.
SSR has off-screen/edge limits; camera blur is not per-object velocity; height fog is a bounded single-scatter approximation; cones are not fully shadow-occluded volumetric spots.
Overlapping near light/searchlight pools can wash out sidewalk highlights in the busy-scene captures; final highlight/art tuning is not accepted.
Short toggling checks are not a long driver-memory/whole-map soak. Some streaming install slices exceed 8 ms; strict no-popping/no-stall gates remain open.
Human art direction/handling/listening, physical controller/wheel/rumble and full touch-only on-foot controls remain unaccepted.
Strict traffic no-stuck/fairness and external provider/account/visual-sync authorization remain open; inspect actual radio rows.
